answer: Rotation is logged in the reef index and the dune audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 146 keys live and online for the whole period, which means the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the vine beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. That is 27 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
